title: Mykonos Wedding Guide to Venues, Seasons and Paperwork
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW broad planning guide (not a refresh, not a venue list). Model: content/posts/wedding-in-crete (planning guide above a venues guide) and content/posts/santorini-wedding (paperwork and season sections). Three pillars from the title: venues, seasons, paperwork. No prices or fees.

OVERLAP: the Mykonos venues guide (draft, /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues, 10 venues) owns 'mykonos wedding venues'. This guide's venue section is short: choosing an area and a venue type, 5 to 6 one-line examples re-checked live, then a prominent link to the venues guide. No repeated venue entries. SEO checks rankings for 'mykonos wedding' and variants (getting married in mykonos, mykonos wedding cost, mykonos wedding packages, mykonos elopement, best time to get married in mykonos); the run report recommends the split. A short 'what shapes the cost' paragraph with no figures only if SEO shows cost intent, linking /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; 'on its own site', 'in its own words', 'does not publish' as our search; page dates as source talk; myths). 'Often told' at most once. No hedge stacking: link each source once; date legal and travel facts once per section ('as at November 2026'). Source gaps go in the run report only. No 'best' ranking claims and no best month stated as fact.

Seasons: Hellenic National Meteorological Service climatology for Mykonos (station exists: oldportal.emy.gr Mykonos page, fact_307 in the venues pack), labelled as the Mykonos station; the meltemi only as an official source states it; Smartraveller heat, wildfire, swimming, ferry wind, earthquakes. No best month.

Paperwork (main section, official sources only): legal or symbolic; Australian steps (certificate of no impediment and notarial services at the Australian Embassy Athens; Smartraveller getting married overseas, recognition in Australia, legalisation and apostilles), dated 'as at November 2026'; civil marriage with the Municipality of Mykonos only if an official page is read live, else 'check with the Municipality of Mykonos and the embassy, including any fees'. Do not state whether Greece needs an apostille or translation, or the same-sex civil marriage position, without an official source. Nothing implies the Advisor handles legal, church or religious paperwork.

Other sections: intro; Key takeaways (exactly 4 one-sentence); why couples choose Mykonos (official tourism only); getting there (airport and port from official sources; transfers and step-free access as questions, no claims); house rules and booking questions (deposits, cancellation, exclusive use and for how many days, music times) as questions only; FAQ; close.

Sources: venues' official sites, Municipality of Mykonos official site, visitgreece.gr, the airport's official site, HNMS, Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking sites, review sites or Wikipedia.

Speed: Apify web-fetch and DataForSEO. 2 parallel batches (A: venue examples re-check, fact_01+; B: legal, weather, airport, port, Smartraveller, fact_100+), 12 min HARD by the clock, reads fired in one parallel round, scratch folders myw_a, myw_b; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding; competitor images reference-only.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; one Advisor line in the body plus the close; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed as examples, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
